title: Creating a multiplayer game from a single prompt in Unity
author: melihkvl
selftext:
Hey r/aigamedev  👋

I wanted to share a short demo of an experiment I’ve been working on with Unity.

The idea explores a different kind of development pipeline:

– start with a single prompt to generate a playable multiplayer prototype,  
– iterate on gameplay again using prompts (movement, obstacles, rewards, etc.),  
– then open the project in Unity for full control and deeper development,  
– and optionally keep iterating later with prompts, even from a mobile device.

On top of that, the same system is imagined as a UGC-style game platform (where players can discover, play, and share games built with this pipeline. Similar in spirit to platforms like HypeHype, but Unity-based).

This video shows an early version of that flow. It’s not meant as a finished product or a game launch, but more as a question to other Unity developers.

I’m genuinely curious:

– Would you be interested in prototyping or iterating games this way?  
– Where would prompts help you, and where would they get in the way?  
– Would you publish your own games to a UGC-style platform like this?  
– As a player, would you play games on a platform built around small, fast, multiplayer experiences?  
– Does the idea of continuing development or even publishing from a mobile device sound useful, or unnecessary?

Would love to hear honest thoughts. Positive or critical.
